name: Finn
source:
"Most of what I'm good at involves skirting the law, so let's talk about baking instead, shall we?"

Major: Biology
Skills: Sneaking, urbex, baking

Lab Partner, Maybe Vampire

Finn is definitely the only person you'll ever meet that's THIS religious about sunscreen use. He has a soft spot for animals and while he comes across cold, is genuinely kind (to anyone that isn't himself, anyway).

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/enamored-risks]itch.io[/url]]
